text: Coastal site: bring anti-oxidant compound and tinned-copper grounding straps, the site store does not stock them. The access gate closes at 17:30 sharp.
Machine room is on level 33. Collect the machine-room key from the lobby security desk and sign the key log; after 20:00 security needs 15 minutes' notice.
The LWT thermowell sits behind the insulation jacket on the left-hand header. Unzip the jacket along the seam instead of cutting it; it re-seals.
The encoder cable shares trunking with the brake feed for the last metre before the KDL16 drive. There is room to re-route it along the left-hand cable tray.
Array rows 6 to 9 exceed 70 °C by 13:00 in September. Schedule string testing before 11:00 and carry at least 3 litres of water per person.
The chiller pads border the forklift lane. Wear hi-vis and put out cones before opening any panel.
String 7 connectors sit under the rack rail. Bring the long 60 cm MC4 unlocking tool; the short one does not reach.
